📚 About This Curriculum

All 12 units are delivered as SCORM packages through SAP Learning. Units 1-8 were developed by the SAP Learning Team and are available now. Units 9-12 extend the curriculum with advanced AI-PMM capabilities and are coming soon.

The curriculum aligns to the PMM Book of Work and SAP Learning Skills framework.
